notes.title: One more small update!
notes.notes:
A much smaller update is here. This time it tweaks how Cereal's collisions work, hopefully making it impossible to get stuck on ledges (as reported by a few people) or get flung off corners. 

Basically, he should feel better to control around edges and corners.



Additionally, the simple dialogue system was reworked so it is much easier to read the tutorial texts as you play! If you already know the controls by now, I suppose this does nothing for you...

Regardless, it's here now!

This will probably be the last update to the Demo unless a huge game breaking bug is found. See y'all until release! Wishlist if you haven't already.

notes.title: Minor Demo Update
notes.notes:
With Steam Next Fest over I wanted to implement some fixes I could make during the week. Mainly small things like improving visibility on buttons and keys. Also expanded the tutorial a bit and changed some graphics in it for more clarity. 

Controls have been made more responsive as well. Additionally, added a new mode for changing speeds "Automatic Mode". This mode makes Cereal walk and run automatically without needing to hold the buttons down.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596164/d3b00246875678f2afbe6cdade55c86fe86e8c5c.png"]

I have heard various persons having trouble with certain controllers. I have been trying hard to find a solution or even a cause for this to not much avail. Still I hope i can find a full proper fix. Sorry to everyone affected by these issues. I urge you to try find something that hopefully works for you in the Steam Controller settings.



That said, I really appreciate the attention my little game has garnered. It's amazing and I am thankful for you all! Thanks for your patience. See ya again!
